quandoUsar: A single date inside a form, with a label, help text, and the calendar opening under the field.
Dates with restrictions: `minDate`, `maxDate`, and `disabledDates` block days, like weekends on a delivery.
When the date can be left empty: the calendar footer has a clear button, which calls `onChange(undefined)`.
quandoEvitar: Use `date-range-picker` to choose the start and end of a period.
Use `calendar` when the month should always be visible on the page, with no field or popover.
For distant dates the person knows by heart, like a birth date: there is no typing, and the year only changes by keyboard or month by month.

teclado.acao: On the field, open the calendar and move focus to the selected day, to today, or to the first available day of the month.
In the calendar, move focus one day or one week, skipping blocked days.
Go to the Sunday or Saturday of the focused week.
On a day, choose the date and close the calendar.
Closes the calendar without changing the date and returns focus to the field.

acessibilidade: The field is a `<button>` with `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and `aria-expanded`, tied to the visible `label` and to `description`; the formatted value also goes in a screen-reader-only text.
On open, focus goes to a day in the calendar; on choosing a day or closing with `Esc`, it returns to the field, and leaving with `Tab` closes the popover.
The popover is a `role="dialog"` with no focus trap, and its texts (`Clear`, `Choose a day`, `Selected …`) are fixed in English, even with `locale`.
movimento: The calendar grows from the field's icon with a short spring and only closes 300 ms after the choice, so the highlight reaches the day.
In the field, only the parts of the date that changed roll: a later date rises from below, an earlier one drops from above.
With “reduce motion” on, everything becomes a fade and the calendar closes immediately after the choice.
responsivo: The popover is `min(320px, 100vw - 32px)`, always opens below the field, left-aligned, and on screens up to 360 px it takes the field's width.
There is no portal or flip upward: leave free space below the field and avoid ancestors with `overflow: hidden`.
notasIA: It is always controlled: keep `Date | undefined` in state and pass `value` and `onChange`; there is no `defaultValue`.
Pass `locale="pt-BR"` (the default is `en-US`) and, for another format in the field, `format` with `Intl.DateTimeFormat` options.
Depends on `calendar`; extra props and `disabled` go to the field's button, and `showToday` adds the today button to the header.
